independence.reason: This reviewer authored Task 17 and Task 18 in the same working session and carries their conclusions in context. The brief's role statement ('You did NOT write this manuscript', 'Do NOT begin from the conclusions of Tasks 17-19') cannot be honoured by this reviewer.
independence.what_is_still_valid: The technical audit: estimand analysis, independent re-derivation of every numeric claim from frozen artifacts, independent resolution of all 257 evidence bindings, and identification of findings the prior tasks did not make. Prior knowledge of the evidence aids rather than impairs these.
independence.what_is_invalid: Any assertion that the manuscript communicates its scope adequately to a reader without repository history. This reviewer cannot simulate that reader.
independence.recommendation: Section 2's cold read should be executed by a reviewer with no exposure to this project: a fresh session, a different model, or a human reader given only paper/main_v0.3.md and the bibliography. Several findings below concern precisely whether a cold reader could follow the paper, and they are the findings this reviewer is least qualified to settle.

note: Estimand table per brief section 4. Each row states what the manuscript measures, not what it says.

estimands.headline: Development joint loss 0.09015 -> 0.08959
estimands.conditioning: origination covariates + duration + cohort (+ macro for M2)
estimands.concern: No complexity adjustment for at least 14 added macro coefficients (seven predictors, two cause logits each). Manuscript states the absence of complexity adjustment correctly. Corrected per T20-C03.

estimands.headline: Seen-vintage temporal joint loss 0.089201 -> 0.105323
estimands.population: Seen-vintage survivor cohort, 5,619 facilities, 248,939 intervals, 2019-01 to 2026-02
estimands.concern: Interval weighting correlates with survival, which is the complement of the modelled payoff event. No facility-weighted sensitivity.

estimands.headline: Calendar 2020 contributes 89.34%
estimands.population: as E2, partitioned by calendar year
estimands.concern: Exact and verified. The estimand is a contribution share, not an effect.

estimands.headline: Pooled payoff AUC 0.56543 -> 0.62587, 98.19% between-year
estimands.metric: Mann-Whitney concordance and its pair-weighted decomposition
estimands.uncertainty_unit: facility clusters ONLY; no calendar-block interval exists
estimands.concern: Two distinct estimand shifts occur here. (a) The unit changes from interval to PAIR, which the manuscript states. (b) The within/between contribution shares depend on the chosen stratum resolution: 17.195%/82.805% at year level, 1.979%/98.021% at month level on a different population. The abstract leads with the resolution-dependent number.

estimands.headline: Within-month AUC 0.56014 vs 0.55974 over 55 months
estimands.population: Eligible-month subpopulation: 191,938 of 248,939 intervals, 55 of 86 months
estimands.statistical_unit: case-control pair within a calendar month
estimands.concern: Different population from E4: its own pooled gain is +0.04831, not +0.06044. Manuscript states this. No uncertainty attached, correctly, but also no equivalence bound.

estimands.headline: Unseen-vintage joint loss 0.070631 -> 0.069811
estimands.conditioning: as E1 with frozen zero-reference cohort encoding
estimands.concern: Six population differences vary simultaneously: vintage, seasoning, survivor selection, calendar exposure, cohort encoding, duration support. No interval. The word 'transport' implies an attributable population shift that this design cannot deliver, as section 4.5 itself concedes.

estimands.headline: CIF comparison, observed 0.3367 vs M1 0.2587 vs M2 0.7581 at 24 months
estimands.conditioning: entry covariates + realized subsequent macro path
estimands.comparator: mean predicted facility CIF vs cohort Aalen-Johansen
estimands.concern: Same cohort and period as E3, so not independent. The observed and modelled quantities are labelled in the Table F caption and section 3.6 (an earlier version of this audit wrongly said they were not; withdrawn per T20-C01).

estimands.headline: Payoff Brier ROBUST_FACILITY_ONLY
estimands.statistical_unit: interval for the point, facility/year for resampling
estimands.concern: Correctly reported. The same treatment is not extended to either AUC.

estimand_shifts_found: Interval -> case-control pair between sections 4.2 and 4.4 (stated by the manuscript).
Full-primary population -> eligible-month subpopulation between the year and month decompositions (stated).
Contribution share is resolution-dependent across the two decompositions (NOT stated).
withdrawn_shifts: Mean-of-individual-CIF vs cohort-level Aalen-Johansen in Table F: withdrawn per T20-C01; the caption and section 3.6 state it.
